title: Cell structure matters only as the visible expression of forces and energy

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Cell structure matters only as the visible expression of forces and energy

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The study of visible cell structure has little value except as part of a dynamical investigation, because the activities of a cell are due to energy and forces, not to particular material particles or structures as such.

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Ch. IV: On the Internal Form and Structure of the Cell

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: In short it would seem evident that, except in relation to a dynamical investigation, the mere study of cell structure has but little value of its own.

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: delphisci On Growth and Form claim extractor

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: D’Arcy Wentworth Thompson, On Growth and Form (1st ed., Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1917), Chapter IV, “On the Internal Form and Structure of the Cell”; topic “Dynamical study of cell structure”. Scope: cells generally, including germ-cells and ova

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on thompson1917-ch04-01: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.37

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Although modern imaging links cell structures to dynamics, the claim primarily ranks explanatory programs rather than specifying a measurable consequence. Any result could be redescribed as structure expressing forces, so it does not cleanly discriminate rivals.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: No non-arbitrary dataset analysis can assign 'little value' to structure or separate material structures from the forces embodied by them without first choosing a philosophical definition of explanatory value.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Structure and dynamics are not mutually exclusive causal categories.

'Value' is normative.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:

discriminating power: 0.1

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: This is a methodological judgment about what kind of cytology is worth doing. Cell images and force measurements can be used for other claims in the chapter, but they do not confirm or refute a statement that structure has little value except inside a dynamical inquiry.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: The sentence ranks the scientific value of descriptive cell anatomy relative to dynamical study. No dataset outcome would raise or lower that value judgment while preserving the wording.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value: Value of a line of study is not a measured biological variable.
